select id, m.title, tagline, original_language, popularity, release_date, revenue, runtime, vote_average, vote_count, genres, production_companies, production_countries, c.cast, c.crew, date_part('year', release_date ) release_year 
from movies m left join credits c on m.id = c.movie_id
where original_language in ('en','fr','es','de','zh','hi','ja','it','cn','ru','ko')
